_about: Versioned metrics registry for DriveSense-VLM. Source of truth for model-vs-model comparison, the regression gate, and drift. All L1/L4 numbers are measured on the FIXED 1,041-frame v3 test set (v2 used a different 345-frame test set, so its L1/L4 are not directly comparable and are null here; v2 contributes the eval_loss trajectory and the naive-scaling data point).

test_set.note: fixed across v3 and v4 for apples-to-apples comparison

v2.note: best generalization; different (345-frame) test set — not directly comparable to v3/v4

v3.note: naive scale-up 2754->7228 doubled eval_loss (0.31->0.66) — generalization hurt

v4.note: targeted +1442 adverse frames; clean train (no overfit) but regressed the mined buckets

gate_policy.rule: BLOCK a candidate if any weak bucket drops below (production - tolerance)
